definitions.short: to mould into a form; especially as a potter ; figuratively, to determine (i.e. form a resolution)
definitions.usage: × earthen, fashion, form, frame, make(-r), potter, purpose.
definitions.full: H3335. yatsar יָצַר verb form, fashion (Late Hebrew in participle יוֺצֵר potter, creator , and derivatives; Phoenician יצר potter ; יצר ᵑ7 Syriac = יֵצֶר etc.; Arabic covenant, contract ; Assyrian êƒêru, as Hebrew, Dl HWB 309 ) — Qal Perfect ׳י Isa 44:10 ; יָצָ֑ר Gen 2:8 ; suffix יְצָרָהּ Isa 45:18 ; 2 masculine יָצַרְתָּ Psa 104:26 8 t. Perfect; Imperfect 3masculine וַיִּ֫יצֶר Gen 2:7 ; וַיִּ֫צֶר 2:19 ; suffix יִצְּרֵהוּ Isa 44:12 ; 1 singular suffix אֶצֳּו֯רְךָ Jer 1:5 ; Participle יוֺצֵר Isa 41:25 20 t.; יֹצֵר 45:18 6 t.; suffix יֹצְרִי 49:5 11 t. suffix; plural יוֺצְרִים 30:14 ; 1Chr 4:23 ; construct יֹצְרֵי Isa 44:9 ; — 1 of human activity: a. of a potter who forms out of clay a vessel Isa 29:16 ; 41:25 ; Jer 18:4 (twice in verse); 18:6 (twice in verse); 1Chr 4:23 ; Lam 4:2 ; Zech 11:13 (twice in verse) (these last two according to Thes SS et al. error for אוֺצָר ); (ה)י ׳כְּלִי potter's vessel 2Sam 17:28 ; Psa 2:9 ; Jer 19:11 ; הי ׳חֹמֶר potter's clay Isa 29:16 ; י ׳נֵבֶל 30:14 ; י ׳בַּקְבֻּק Jer 19:1 הי ׳בית 18:2-3 ,. b. of a carver of wood, graven images Isa 44:9-10 , 12 ; Hab 2:18 (twice in verse). c. frame, devise in the mind ׳י עָמָל Psa 94:20 . 2 of divine activity: a. (as a potter) forming Adam out of עפר from אדמה Gen 2:7-8 , (J), beasts and birds, also from אדמה 2:19 (J); Israel as a people Isa 27:11 ; 43:1 , 21 ; 44:21 ; 45:9 (twice in verse); 45:11 ; 64:7 , even from the womb 44:2 , 24 ; the servant of Yahweh from the womb 49:5 ; of the formation of the individual man 43:7 ; Jeremiah in the womb Jer 1:5 ; the eye of man Psa 94:9 ; the locust Amos 7:1 ; Leviathan Psa 104:26 ; the dry land 95:5 ; the earth Isa 45:18 (twice in verse); the mountains Amos 4:13 ; הַכֹּל Jer 10:16 = 51:19 . Figurative perhaps lost sight of in some of the above, and quite certainly in the forming of light Isa 45:7 , of summer and winter Psa 74:17 , the רוּחַ of man Zech 12:1 , and the לב of men Psa 33:15 . b. figurative for frame, pre-ordain, plan (in divine purpose), of a situation מֵרָחוֺק Isa 22:11 ; of an occurrence קֶדֶם מִימֵי 37:26 = 2Kin 19:25 ; אֶעֱשֶׂנָּה אַף יָצַרְתִּי I have planned, I will also do it 2Ki 46:11; ׳י על רעה Jer 18:11 ; ׳י לַהֲכִינָהּ devised it to establish it 33:2 . Niph`al Perfect אֵל לֹאנֿוֺצַר לְפָנַי Isa 43:10 before me a god was not formed (created). Pu`al Perfect יצָֻּ֑רוּ יָמִים days (that) were pre-ordained (in the divine purpose) Psa 139:16 (compare Qal, 2 b ). Hoph`al Imperfect יִצְלָ֑ח לֹא עָלַיִךְ יוּצַר כָּלכְּֿלִי Isa 54:17 any weapon that is formed against thee will not prosper .
